scope.method: Capture requests exercised by Python, native Rust, direct WASM, Node, and writer execution tests; replay successful requests through the WASM analyze API. Native requests capture parsed payloads; legacy Python payloads use FormatRegistry before replay. Type-inference-only requests are replayed separately without asserting input-dependent unresolved paths.
excludes: Incomplete source used only for editor completion
Debugger-only source and watch expressions requiring session/frame context
scope.originalExecutionTests: Rust workspace passed; Python: 1232 passed and 5 xfailed; direct WASM: 29 passed; Node: 68 passed

corpus.unresolvedCandidateInterpretation: Candidates require review. Optional or intentionally missing fields and empty arrays can legitimately produce unresolved paths; the count is not a count of confirmed defects.

minimizedCases.interpretation: 15 minimized cases: the fixed range control passes; 14 further analysis gaps reproduce. Every case executes successfully and returns its independently specified expected result. sourceTest identifies the existing test from which the case was minimized.

confirmedGapFamilies.finding: References inside $(...) strings are omitted, potentially leaving a calculated field without its upstream dependencies.
Lambda, using, match-case, and update-case locals are reported as external dependencies.
update, at, when, matches, replace, mask, and with can be returned as references. Adding to/mod/pow alone does not cover the language.
Letters inside /.../ regex literals are scanned as identifiers.
Module qualifiers and type literals are mistaken for payload dependencies.
payload.*name produces a spurious bare name reference and loses the qualified field path.
Bare payload is incorrectly unresolved even when a payload is supplied. Empty-path lookup does not resolve to the context value itself.
Working coercion/arithmetic and object-spread expressions can throw parser errors during type inference, so dependency extraction never runs.

dealApiImpact.observation: Deal API invokes analyze before building dependencies and rethrows analysis errors as invalid calculations. It filters some double-parenthesized lambda names with a regex; this mitigates a subset of lambda false positives, but not the general scoping issue. Full-script import/type cases establish shared runtime gaps; Deal API itself accepts expression-only formulas.
dealApiImpact.deploymentStatus: Audit only. No additional runtime fixes or package release performed.

replay.exitCode: 1 reports confirmed expectation mismatches or analysis errors. Unresolved candidates alone do not fail the audit.

inferenceOnlySupplement.note: These 34 additional expressions passed Python type inference. Symbolic DWType arguments have no concrete payload, so missing-reference counts are not an oracle.
